title: phantom
features:
Combat
AutoClicker – Automatically performs clicks/attacks without manual input
AimAssist – Helps aim at targets more accurately
TriggerBot – Automatically fires when an enemy is detected in your crosshair
FastStop – Instantly stops movement for better accuracy/control
Movement

Speed – Increases player movement speed
Fly – Allows the player to fly
Gravity – Adjusts or removes gravity effects
NoClip – Walk through walls/objects
CFrame – Directly manipulates position/teleportation
AntiFall – Prevents fall damage or falling
Visuals
ESP – Shows players/objects through walls
FovChanger – Adjusts field of view
BreadCrumbs – Leaves a trail behind the player
AnimationPlayer – Plays custom animations
FPSBooster – Improves performance / increases FPS
Utility
AntiAFK – Prevents being kicked for inactivity
AutoRejoin – Automatically rejoins the game after leaving/disconnect
Rejoin – Manually rejoin the current game/server
ServerHop – Switch to a different server automatically
Antideath – Prevents or avoids death (depending on implementation)
